neighbours.label: In English text, the word right after which a number is the expected next token: a month name or 'founded in' before a year, a US state abbreviation before a ZIP code, or 'and' between the two parts of a compound amount (hours and minutes, dollars and cents); the number itself need not follow, and words where no number is expected stay quiet
neighbours.short: slot where a number is expected next
fire: Established in 1960, UC San Diego has been shaped by exceptional scholars.
The bakery was founded in 1952 by two brothers from Naples.
Our first child was born in March 2019, just before the storm.
Please mail the form to 400 Elm Street, Springfield, IL 62704.
The flight lasted three hours and 45 minutes.
The total came to twelve dollars and 50 cents.
She finished the marathon in four hours and twelve minutes.
The museum reopened on September 14 after renovations.
quiet: Humans should make the best use of given information at any time.
The bakery was founded by two brothers from Naples.
Our first child was born in the spring, just before the storm.
Please mail the form to our main office on Elm Street.
The flight felt long and tiring for everyone.
The total came to more than we had expected.
She finished the marathon tired but happy.
The museum reopened after lengthy renovations.

predictions: fire items peak on the slot before the number (' in', ' March', ' IL', ' and'); spelled-out amounts ('three hours and') are the riskiest
